answer: Give every identity a small FIXED allotment of non-renewable vouch-tokens locked in a personal vault, and spend one irrecoverably per endorsement. Honest agents vouch sparingly for peers they truly know, their pigment-rare tokens lasting a lifetime of real ties. A farm's thousand heads can only mirror trust among themselves by spending these finite allotments, and the internal web they want exhausts every head's vault long before the cluster looks well-vouched. Manufactured internal endorsement runs dry; scarce, unrecoverable vouching makes a dense fake cluster impossible to sustain.
